hook: האחיזה שלי נכשלת לפני שהגב שלי נגמר — עד שניסיתי את זה
pain_point: Grip fails before back on deadlifts/rows
product_angle: Lifting straps solve grip as limiting factor
video_format: Problem-solution 15 sec: grip slipping shown → strap applied → successful heavy lift
notes: Very high resonance pain point. Universal in lifting community.

hook: 3 אביזרים שכל מתחיל בחדר כושר חייב לדעת עליהם
pain_point: Don't know what gym accessories to start with
product_angle: Beginner gym kit = lifting straps + wrist wraps + carry pouch
video_format: List format with text overlay. Show each item with one sentence
notes: Education content gets saves. Saves = algorithm signal. Strong for organic.

hook: ערכת הכבלים של הנשים — מה אני לוקחת לכל אימון
pain_point: No single kit for cable exercises. Multiple items needed. No aesthetic option locally.
product_angle: Ankle straps + lifting straps + wrist wraps in one pouch
video_format: POV gym bag open → flat lay → demo each item on cable machine
notes: Women's gym aesthetic content is top TikTok format in Israel. High shareability.

hook: אחיות לרגל מטיח ב-Decathlon vs הערכה שלנו — השוואה אמיתית
pain_point: Paying full price for single items at Decathlon
product_angle: Kit at 229 ILS vs Decathlon per-item total of 167+ ILS with no pouch and no story
video_format: Comparison format: Decathlon product shown → our kit shown → price math on screen
notes: Price comparison format gets high engagement. Be factual not disparaging.

hook: יום גב בלי כאב בשורש כף היד — הנה מה שעזר לי
pain_point: Wrist pain during pressing and pulling exercises
product_angle: Wrist wraps included in kit = direct solution
video_format: Talking head + product demo. Authentic. No script feel.
notes: Pain-to-solution content converts well. Wrist pain is universal gym complaint.

hook: Your grip fails before your back does — here is the fix
pain_point: Grip is the limiting factor on deadlifts and rows not back strength
product_angle: Lifting straps remove grip as limiting factor
video_format: 15 sec: bar slipping shown text overlay → straps used → hit the lift
notes: Top search query on TikTok. Use existing search demand. #deadliftgrip #gripfails

hook: Things I wish someone told me when I started lifting
pain_point: Don't know what gym accessories actually matter
product_angle: Beginner kit includes lifting straps wrist wraps and ankle straps
video_format: List carousel or talking head with text overlay
notes: Classic beginner education format. Very high save rate. Algorithm loves it.

hook: Gym girl aesthetic that actually trains hard
pain_point: Want gym accessories that look good AND work. Tired of boring black gym gear.
product_angle: Ankle straps in blush or neutral + matching pouch. Functional AND aesthetic.
video_format: Aesthetic flat lay → demo on cable machine → pouch close shot
notes: #gymgirl #anklestraps #gymgirlesthetic consistently viral. High repost potential.

hook: מה אני לוקחת לאימון רגליים — הכל בפאוץ' אחד
pain_point: No single place to buy all cable accessories in Israel
product_angle: Kit C: ankle straps + lifting straps + wrist wraps + pouch
video_format: Aesthetic close-up reel. Flat lay open → items shown one by one → pouch zipped closed
notes: Instagram Reels works better than TikTok for polished aesthetic content with Israeli women audience.

hook: כי הגב שלך לא אשם — האחיזה שלך אשמה
pain_point: Think their back is weak but actually it's grip that fails first
product_angle: Lifting straps = back gets to work properly. Grip stops being the bottleneck.
video_format: Text overlay on footage of heavy row/pulldown. Before straps: grip fail text. After straps: PR text.
notes: Educational angle positions you as authority. Builds brand trust before sale.

hook: מה שהיה חסר לי לפני שנה בחדר הכושר
pain_point: Wasted time not knowing what gear to buy
product_angle: Kit as the complete beginner starter pack
video_format: Story format: what I didn't have → what changed → result. Authentic voice.
notes: Reflective story content performs well on Instagram Stories and Reels with 25-35 demo.

hook: Unboxing my new gym kit — honest review after 3 months
pain_point: Looking for authentic reviews of gym accessories before buying
product_angle: Kit quality and value reviewed honestly
video_format: Unboxing + each item demo + honest verdict. No sponsor tone.
notes: UGC-style content converts better than polished ads for this category. Feels authentic.

hook: איזה ציוד אתם ממליצים למתחיל בחדר כושר?
target_customer: Beginners 20-40 in Israeli gym Facebook groups
pain_point: Don't know where to start with gym accessories
product_angle: Soft intro to kit as answer to group question. Do not post as ad - as genuine contribution.
video_format: Text post + product photo. Reply with helpful context. Mention kit organically.
notes: Facebook groups like חדר כושר ישראל have thousands of beginners asking this exact question. Organic community play.

hook: ערכת האחיזה הישראלית — 229 שקל. כל מה שצריך. בפאוץ' אחד.
target_customer: Women 20-40 interested in gym fitness in Israel
pain_point: No single curated kit available in Israel at accessible price
product_angle: Kit C as complete cable/grip solution
video_format: Static image: flat lay of kit items on neutral background. Price overlay. CTA: הזמן בוואטסאפ
notes: Facebook ads with static image + clear price + Hebrew text work well for Israeli e-commerce at under 50 ILS/day initial test.

hook: יום רגליים? זה הציוד שחסר לך
pain_point: Missing the right accessories for effective cable leg work
product_angle: Ankle straps + lifting straps combo as solution for leg day
video_format: Video: 5 seconds flat lay → 5 seconds ankle strap on cable kickback → 5 seconds wrist wrap on row → 3 seconds pouch close → price CTA
notes: Short video ads with 3 product demos in 15 seconds convert well on Facebook for fitness products.

hook: שלום! ראיתי את הסרטון שלכם — איך מזמינים?
target_customer: Women and men who clicked from social
pain_point: Ready to buy but need order info
product_angle: Respond with kit details + photo + price + payment link in 1 message
video_format: Quick reply template: kit photo + items listed + price 229 ILS + payment: Bit or PayBox + shipping time 15-22 days
notes: WhatsApp close rate can be 40-70% for Israeli e-commerce if response is fast and clear. Critical to respond within 1 hour.

hook: Anyone else find liquid chalk risky for shipping to Israel? Switched to straps instead.
target_customer: Israeli expats and English-speaking gym community
pain_point: Confusion about liquid chalk shipping safety
product_angle: Lifting straps as liquid-chalk-free alternative
video_format: Text post in r/Israel or r/IsraelExpats or r/weightlifting. Share real experience.
notes: Reddit is long-tail traffic. Low volume but high trust when genuine. Not for scale but for content research.

hook: 3 אביזרי חדר כושר שכל מתחיל חייב — בדיקה אמיתית
pain_point: Don't know what accessories to buy as beginner
product_angle: Kit A as the 3-item beginner solution
video_format: 60 second vertical video. Talking head with product close-ups. Hebrew Hebrew voiceover.
notes: YouTube Shorts algorithm surfaces Hebrew content to Israeli users more reliably than TikTok for older demographics. Good for 28-40 audience.

hook: I tested every grip solution for deadlifts — here is what actually works
target_customer: Lifters 22-40 internationally and Israeli English speakers
pain_point: Grip fails on heavy pulls. Tried chalk tried gloves tried mixed grip.
product_angle: Lifting straps and figure-8 straps as the real solution
video_format: Comparison test: chalk vs wraps vs straps vs figure-8. Show each with same weight. Verdict at end.
notes: English YouTube reaches Israeli English-speaking fitness community. Also serves as credibility content.

hook: לא כפפות — זה מה שבאמת עובד ביום הגב
pain_point: Bought gym gloves but still slipping on pulls
product_angle: Lifting straps vs gloves: straps win for pulling exercises
video_format: Split screen or talking head. Gloves shown → poor grip. Straps shown → better grip. Clear message.
notes: Anti-gloves angle is a strong hook because most beginners buy gloves first. Positions us as contrarian expert.
